answer_summary:
SynapseNetwork offers the Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server, enabling AI assistants like Claude, GitHub Copilot, and Cursor to directly query Synapse for tasks such as dataset searches, entity metadata inspection, project hierarchy exploration, and provenance tracing. This server is implemented in Python and built upon the `synapseclient` package, mirroring the capabilities available through the Synapse Python client. ([python-docs.synapse.org](https://python-docs.synapse.org/en/v4.12.2-develop.4/guides/synapse_mcp/?utm_source=openai))

To integrate the Synapse MCP Server with AI tools, you can utilize the following methods:

- **Remote Server (Recommended):** The hosted MCP server at `https://mcp.synapse.org/mcp` supports OAuth2 authentication, eliminating the need for token management. For instance, to add this server to Claude Code (CLI), you can execute:

  ```bash
  claude mcp add --transport http synapse -- https://mcp.synapse.org/mcp
  ```

  Upon first use, Claude Code will prompt for OAuth2 login through a browser window. ([python-docs.synapse.org](https://python-docs.synapse.org/en/v4.12.2-develop.4/guides/synapse_mcp/?utm_source=openai))
